title: Preparing for Dynamics 365 for Sales for Integration

facts.text: Must have System Administrator security role or equivalent privileges in Dynamics 365 Sales to complete integration setup tasks.
Create non-interactive user account in Dynamics 365 Sales with privileges to write, read, modify, delete integrated entities data.
Install Business Central integration solution by copying DynamicsNAVIntegrationSolution zip file from CrmCustomization folder on installation media.
Use DynamicsNAVIntegrationSolution_v8.zip for CRM version 8.x and earlier; use _v9.zip for version 9.0 and later.
Import solution zip in Dynamics 365 Sales to add Business Central Connection and Account Statistics entities and integration security roles.
Assign Business Central Integration Administrator role to connection user and Business Central Integration User role to users needing integration features.
Do not use connection user account to manually modify integrated entity records in Dynamics 365 Sales as changes will be ignored by synchronization.
